'''BvK Fleet Systems''' was a manufacturer of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components. One of their products was the [[GalaxyGuard Mk. VII]] [[Shield booster/Legends|shield booster]], which could be purchased on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="JGG" /> at some point before the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] took place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]] died during the film. As Tyerell was shown to be alive in ''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]'', it must have taken place before the events of ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref>
